LanguageData.RP_Unit_HeaderTip: Name one guard to each wing. They patrol it when free and get to know its inmates day by day - the inmates come to trust them, they notice what goes on, and fewer complaints are filed against them there. The longer they stay, the more the wing's fixers count on knowing them. Moving them to another wing, or taking them off, starts the days again.
LanguageData.RP_Unit_RowTip:
The unit officer of the {0}.
- Each day, every inmate of the wing who was near them gives them {1} points of trust (one restraint costs {2}), never past {3} from that alone. Being around makes acquaintances, not forgiveness - an inmate who resents them gains nothing until the grudge has faded, so a brutal officer stays hated. - Each day, a chance of {4}% rising to {5}% (after ten days) that they bring one hidden fact about the wing to the desk, as an informant's tip would. - Complaints against them from the wing are filed up to {6}% less often as they get to know it (not by an inmate who resents them). - A fixer on the wing finds them up to {7} points likelier to say yes, growing with the days in post.
An officer on days leaves the nights uncovered, and the other way round. On leave or suspended the slot is vacant until they are back (their days are kept, and do not grow while they are away), and naming someone else meanwhile ends their post. While the state's chief deploys the guards the officers' effects wait.
